title: Veiled Dragon Sorceress
description: A dark-skinned bald woman with glowing golden eyes and gold facial markings stands at the center, partially veiled by translucent white fabric. She is entwined by two ornate turquoise serpentine dragons with multiple glowing orange eyes, set against a cosmic night sky filled with stars, aurora, koi fish, cherry blossoms, ancient ruins, and a black cat-like silhouette with glowing white eyes.
prompt: A striking dark-skinned bald woman with glowing golden eyes and golden speckles on her face, entwined by two long ornate turquoise dragons with multiple glowing orange eyes and flowing manes. A black cat-like shadow figure with glowing white eyes and horns stands behind her. Translucent white veil flows across the scene. Cosmic starry background with aurora borealis, swimming koi fish, cherry blossoms, ancient stone ruins, and floating crystals, in a vibrant surreal fantasy style.
